definitions.recall_at_k: Per query: distinct relevant (source, section) labels in top k / all gold labels; then macro mean.
definitions.mrr_at_k: Mean of 1 / first relevant rank within top k; zero if absent. This is truncated MRR@k, not unbounded MRR.
definitions.multi_section: All listed sections count toward Recall; MRR rewards the first relevant section only.
definitions.all_labeled_diagnostic: Includes abstain questions whose gold labels identify escalation evidence; this is not answer or abstention accuracy.
